name: FrameBot
description: Frame-perfect macro bot with frame stepper, swift clicks and speedhack (desktop + mobile). Kills you near the end of the level if any assist was used.

speed.name: Speed multiplier
speed.description: Stacks multiplicatively with other mods' speedhacks. 1.0 = off.

swift-cps.name: Swift click CPS
swift-cps.description: Clicks per second while Swift Clicks is on (frame-locked).

tps.name: Physics TPS
tps.description: Physics ticks per second (GD default is 240). Used by the stepper and swift clicks.

kill-percent.name: Kill at percent
kill-percent.description: If any assist was used this attempt, you die at this percent.

show-menu.name: Show on-screen menu
show-menu.description: Touch buttons in the level (needed on mobile; optional on desktop).

menu-x.name: Menu X position (%)
menu-x.description: Horizontal position of the on-screen menu, as a percent of screen width. Applies next time you enter a level.

menu-y.name: Menu Y position (%)
menu-y.description: Vertical position of the on-screen menu, as a percent of screen height (100 = top).

menu-horizontal.name: Horizontal menu
menu-horizontal.description: Lay the buttons out in a row instead of a column.
